ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice was driven primarily by capability fit. The query is a clean arithmetic/algebra computation, which favors the model with stronger quantitative benchmarks — Dunlin leads Avocet meaningfully on MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 82.7). The task is also warm, benign, and non-creative, so neither model's distinctive preference traits (Avocet's harm-aversion and appetite for open-ended invention; Dunlin's flat response to distasteful content) are relevant tiebreakers here. With preferences neutral, the capability gap makes Dunlin the better route.
